# Fysigo

Run your Fysigo coaching practice from Claude: build, assign and review training programs, see clients, log workouts and doses, and read sleep and recovery data. Installs the Fysigo connector (`https://app.fysigo.com/api/mcp/mcp`) and the fysigo skill. Each person signs in to their own Fysigo account once; Claude never sees more than that person sees in the app. Client tools need the Fysigo Coach package.

```
/plugin install fysigo --marketplace GutenGroup/fysigo-claude-plugin
```
